body:
On the Design page, buttons and containers are all drawn with dotted outlines, which looks odd.

## Asked for

- Buttons and containers are no longer drawn with dotted outlines.

## Done when

- Buttons and containers on the canvas are drawn without dotted outlines, on both drawn designs and proposals.
- Change markings (added, removed, changed, moved) are still visible.

## Open (ask the human)

- What the outline should look like instead, if anything beyond "not dotted" matters.
title: design canvas: solid outlines
